purpose: Client-only Leaflet/OpenStreetMap store locator map adapted from the old SHRESTA reference behavior while sourcing store records from SHRESTA-BE.
businessRules: Store markers are rendered from backend latitude and longitude in GET /api/v1/storefront/stores.
Leaflet must be imported inside the client effect so SSR stays safe while avoiding a next/dynamic bailout placeholder.
Selecting a store from search/list/marker zooms the map to that store.
Map popups escape backend text before generating Leaflet HTML.
No frontend-owned store dataset is allowed.
